mathematical_meanings: Left image: x names the horizontal coordinate axis (the right tip of the horizontal axis beside the V-shaped graph). Right image: x names the horizontal coordinate axis (the right end of the horizontal axis passing through a circle).
Rationales: In both images, x names the horizontal coordinate axis. The relevant locations are the right tip of the horizontal axis beside the V-shaped graph on the left and the right end of the horizontal axis passing through a circle on the right.
